offering_description.value: Gentex supplies automakers with rearview mirrors, camera-based vision systems and vehicle electronics. It also sells home audio equipment and consumer accessories, dimmable windows for aircraft, and fire detection and signaling devices for buildings. It designs and manufactures core products, supplying vehicle and aircraft manufacturers directly and reaching consumers through retail and online channels.

primary_products.value: Auto-dimming and camera-display rearview mirrors; vehicle access, security and entertainment electronics; home audio equipment and consumer accessories; dimmable aircraft windows; fire detection and signaling devices

customer_segment.value: B2B: Automakers, aircraft manufacturers, automotive aftermarket dealers, consumer electronics retailers and fire protection distributors; B2C: Home audio buyers and shoppers for consumer electronics accessories

end_markets.value: Passenger vehicles; automotive aftermarket; consumer electronics and home audio; commercial aviation; building fire safety

revenue_model.value: product sales: Vehicle mirrors and electronics, consumer audio and accessories, aircraft windows and fire safety devices

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns glass, coatings and electronic components into products for automakers, aircraft manufacturers, electronics retailers and fire protection distributors

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia

specialization.value: diversified: Automotive vision and electronics, consumer audio and accessories, aircraft dimmable windows, and building fire safety

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Supply relationships with automakers and aircraft manufacturers; distributors / dealers: Automotive aftermarket dealers, specialty audio dealers and fire protection distributors; third-party retail: Consumer electronics and home audio retailers; online: Company-operated and third-party storefronts for audio equipment and accessories
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Vehicle rear-visibility standards, aircraft airworthiness requirements, and fire alarm product standards and building codes

notes: The current scope of the acquired consumer accessory lines is uncertain.
